info.name: HustleHub+ API
info.description:
HustleHub+ Part 2 - secure freelance marketplace. Run order doubles as an end-to-end test suite:
 1) Health, 2) Register, 3) Login (tokens captured), 4) Gigs CRUD + RBAC, 5) Bookings (+ simulated transactions),
 6) Income aggregation, 7) Cleanup & delete, 8) Protected routes, 9) Security & hardening.

Prerequisites: backend running on https://localhost:3443 with the demo data seeded (npm run seed in backend/).
Execute: newman run "HustleHub+ Postman Collection.json" (installed via npm i -D newman; see backend/package.json test:newman).

NOTE: the final request intentionally triggers the login rate limiter (10 attempts / 15 min / IP) and will return 429.
Restart the backend to reset rate-limit counters before running the suite again.
